_comment: Every upstream document a rule depends on. The weekly source-watch workflow runs tools/watch_sources.py, which fetches url (or watch_url when the canonical page blocks automated clients), compares the hash with sha256, and opens an issue on change. Run tools/watch_sources.py --update after re-verifying.

osrf-genai-policy.watch_note: osralliance.org returns 403 to automated clients; the policy announcement thread on Discourse is watched instead, and a change there means re-reading the policy page by hand.
